column2: The town has grown, and stat shards and mythic gear have been reorganized.
{}. The town has grown and stone roads were laid. The four nearest zones moved slightly outward.
{}. Guide quests that introduce new features now appear between main quests.
{}. The Smithy's "Salvage All at Once" now salvages your bag · vault · mercenary loot in one go. Expedition loot can be set to salvage automatically.
{}. Stat shards now have grades and Excellent shards. Sage Era can grind · combine · draw shards.
{}. Mythic Exchange became "Trace Exchange" (Quality Polishing · Mythic Affix Reroll · Excellent Slot Expansion tickets).
{}. The Workshop gained storage, and Mine · Herb Field production doubled. Skilled mercenaries yield more rare materials.
{}. Auto-hunt stops when potions run out or you fall, and dropped gear no longer disappears.
{}. Removed the pause after basic attacks for better control, and skill effects now scale with skill tier.
{}. Research · mercenary wages cost more gold. Reduced stutter and fixed several bugs.
New content: "Horde Subjugation" · "Throne Expedition" · "Endless Hell".
{}. Horde Subjugation: when a horde gathers in a boss-cleared zone, go subjugate it via Guard Captain Hagen.
{}. Throne Expedition: a boss raid against a lord who changes every week.
{}. Endless Hell: a new, endless World Tier.
{}. Transcendent Enhancement unlocked, and town buildings can be upgraded to Lv.{}.
{}. Skills were reorganized, and you can use up to three quick slot sets.
{}. Gear affixes now fit your class, and potions are auto-used even when hunting manually.
{}. Adjusted difficulty at high World Tiers and fixed several bugs.
Polished boss fights and auto-hunt.
{}. Polished boss fights and made auto-hunt more convenient.
{}. Bows and quivers can be equipped together; ring · amulet · quiver enhancement changed.
{}. Polished chat and phone skill buttons.
New title screen and character art.
{}. New title and loading screens.
{}. New character portraits, which you can change in Settings.
{}. You can start right away as a guest.
{}. Skill shapes were reworked and effects made more spectacular.
{}. Tidied up the town and reduced brief stutters while hunting.
Chat and rankings added; more Awakening title traits.
{}. Chat added.
{}. Ranking window added.
{}. Each Awakening title now offers new traits.
{}. {} new skills added; one-handed and two-handed weapons follow separate paths.
{}. Skill slots increased to {}, and the game screen layout changed.
{}. New fields and icons, and skillbooks now stack.
{}. Enhancement now raises all base stats of gear.
{}. Town products are collected directly at buildings. The guidebook was rewritten.
{}. Gear dropped on death is no longer lost. Fixed several bugs.
All windows renewed; hidden dungeons · dungeon mutations · empowered monsters added.
{}. All building and window screens were renewed.
{}. Hidden dungeons added.
{}. Dungeon mutations added.
{}. Empowered monsters added.
{}. Salvaging and gem combining can be done by grade, and irreversible actions ask for confirmation.
{}. Fixed several bugs.
Flooded zones · Uncharted Lands · Relic Altar · Training Arts added, and combat changed greatly.
{}. Flooded zones: monsters flood zones left alone too long. Purify them for rewards.
{}. Uncharted Lands and the Relic Altar added.
{}. Training Arts added.
{}. Features for hybrid characters and a monster codex added.
{}. Rebalanced combat calculations and the roles of stats.
{}. Skills were overhauled, and daggers · grimoires added.
{}. Herbs · crafting · requests · town production expanded, with new abilities for the Expedition Hall and Lodging. Mercenaries are paid daily wages.
{}. Reduced screen stutter and fixed several bugs.
Growth speed and endgame changed greatly; Mythic grade added.
{}. Growth speed and the endgame changed greatly.
{}. Buildings unlocked up to Lv.{}, and enhancement up to +{}.
{}. Dungeon difficulties and Mythic gear added.
{}. More skills per Awakening tier, and skill quality (Low · Mid · High Grade) added.
{}. Named · bosses always drop gear, and mythic · legendary gear became rarer.
{}. Town mercenaries and automation greatly improved.
{}. Bosses gained new patterns, with new monster · boss · icon art.
{}. Fixed several bugs, including loading freezes.
New starting weapons, Awakening {}, and a mailbox.
{}. Two new starting weapons and Awakening {} added.
{}. Mailbox and notices added.
{}. Rebalanced time spent and difficulty per zone.
{}. All skillbooks gained Awakening tiers, and new skills were added.
{}. You can choose gear to equip on mercenaries.
{}. New monster · gear art · skill effects · skill icons, with renewed base buildings and ruins.
{}. The Smithy · Jeweler can also handle gear in your bag · vault.
The world expanded to {} zones, and the Jeweler arrived.
{}. {} new zones opened, expanding the world to {} zones. Defeat a zone's boss to open its dungeon.
{}. The Jeweler arrived.
{}. The same gear now rolls different stats each time, and a new gear tier was added.
{}. Enhancement stones and building materials became bag items.
{}. Change gear affixes with stat shards at the Smithy.
{}. All gear has stat requirements, and overall difficulty and rewards were heavily adjusted.
Smarter auto-hunt and smoother graphics.
{}. Auto-hunt stays inside the zone where it was turned on and finds its way around.
{}. The screen became much smoother.
{}. A quest panel was added, and daily request rewards are claimed from the Guard Captain.
{}. A shared vault chest was added to town, and the guidebook was renewed.
The game was renamed Éveil ({}), with town · mercenaries · skill growth added.
{}. The game was renamed Éveil ({}).
{}. Four outer-ring zones opened, along with the codex · pets · day and night.
{}. Terrain and dungeons changed greatly.
{}. Mercenaries visit the inn, and can be assigned to buildings or sent on expeditions.
{}. You can create multiple characters.
{}. Stat shards and the vault were added.
{}. Skills grow endlessly, and each skill has unique variants.
{}. Boss attack patterns greatly increased.
{}. The game updates automatically when a new version is released.
